    Fischbacher's Lemma 4.2: parallel paths have the same value #

    In an interval-finite ray category without oriented cycles in which every cocycle on a finite convex set is a coboundary there, two paths with the same endpoints have the same value (pathVal_eq_of_parallel; Fischbacher, Zur Kombinatorik der Algebren mit endlich vielen Idealen, Lemma 4.2, "insbesondere"). Induction on the interval [a, b]: the last arrows of the two paths lie in one component of the morphisms into b (sepComp_of_coboundary), and along such a component the value of "a path from a, then the morphism" is constant by induction.
